build.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
export DOTNET_ROOT=/workspace/.g-pc-health-tools/dotnet DOTNET_CLI_HOME=/workspace/.g-pc-health-tools/dotnet-home NUGET_PACKAGES=/workspace/.g-pc-health-tools/nuget DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER=0
cd /workspace/work/gpc-controller57/snapshot
mkdir -p src/G.PcHealthCheck/obj
cp /workspace/work/gpc-native-fresh-recovery-20261009/product-worktree/src/G.PcHealthCheck/obj/project.assets.json src/G.PcHealthCheck/obj/
cp /workspace/work/gpc-native-fresh-recovery-20261009/product-worktree/src/G.PcHealthCheck/obj/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj.nuget.g.* src/G.PcHealthCheck/obj/
/workspace/.g-pc-health-tools/dotnet/dotnet --version
/workspace/.g-pc-health-tools/dotnet/dotnet publish src/G.PcHealthCheck/G.PcHealthCheck.csproj --no-restore -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:EnableWindowsTargeting=true -p:DesignTimeBuild=true -p:GeneratedBrandDir=/workspace/work/gpc-0171/brand -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -p:NuGetAudit=false -p:UseSharedCompilation=false -p:InformationalVersion=0.17.1+ca354d2194a454b0356057c2db34e94cea8ffbbe -p:IncludeSourceRevisionInInformationalVersion=false --disable-build-servers -warnaserror -o /workspace/work/gpc-controller57/publish --verbosity minimal
mv /workspace/work/gpc-controller57/publish/G-PC-Health.exe /workspace/work/gpc-controller57/publish/G-PC-Health-0.17.1-huawei-candidate.exe
